scope: Exploratory fixed-checkpoint answer-format diagnostics on prepared validation only. All checkpoints and data are read-only.
medbook: The frozen canonical greedy scorer plus one-token constrained A-D scores after a fixed assistant prefix, both canonical order and a left-rotation by one position. Boxed or bare exact A-D is valid format, scored independently of correctness.
pathvqa: The frozen greedy scorer, split by normalized gold yes/no (3125) versus other short answers (3134). Report yes/no type compliance and generated token total separately from correctness.
privacy: Publish aggregates only. Per-row diagnostics contain numeric correctness, type and length metrics without question text, IDs, images or decoded predictions; retain privately.
